notes: The prompt says roleplay outright and its personalization is entirely avatar morphs with no property, which is the Morph Roleplay preset exactly. I kept the preset's options but swapped its settlement-static shape for interior-single, because the answers put the whole map indoors under one big top rather than in a pre-built town, and interior-single is in this genre's typical list; social-hub becomes the tent floor sized for a crowd, vignette-photo the ring and booths people take roleplay screenshots in, and landmark-focal the centre ring you orient by. Decided without a user: the small entrance area is the tent's own foyer under the canvas rather than an outdoor fairground, and the VIP room is a partitioned lounge off the main floor rather than a separately generated building - with no exterior in the map there is no outside-to-inside transition to link, so this stays on P0 instead of picking up building-interior's P3. The 1000-dollar VIP price is economy rather than layout, the space just has to be gateable, and no option covers the morph pads the game needs, so they have to reach the image prompt as tent furniture.
